description: This file is a PHP script for managing custom field mappings in the Leads module of vtiger CRM. It includes functions to retrieve and process custom field data, and renders a template for custom field mapping configuration.

methods.name: customFieldMappings
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs an array of custom field mappings for the Leads module.

methods.name: getModuleValues
methods.description: Fetches module-specific fields and their attributes, used within customFieldMappings.
